# Vendored Chart.js 4.5.1

Source: official npm package https://registry.npmjs.org/chart.js/-/chart.js-4.5.1.tgz

`chart.umd.min.js.txt` is the **unmodified** `package/dist/chart.umd.min.js` from that archive, stored with a `.txt` suffix so the bundler imports it as inert text. Its banners identify Chart.js 4.5.1 and bundled @kurkle/color 0.3.2. The archive was checked against its registry SHA-512 integrity before extraction; manifest.json records that integrity and SHA-256/byte sizes for the vendored files. Builds verify the latter without network access.

Both packages use MIT licenses. Preserve both LICENSE text files when distributing this source. Built client bundles carry the code banners, lib/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt carries the full licenses, and chart HTML exports embed both licenses.

No package installation scripts were run. Do not replace this release in place: add a new library identifier and compatibility plan when upgrading.
